Q-0-1.title: Internal Error
Q-0-1.message_template: An internal error occurred. This is a bug in Quarto.

Q-0-99.title: Generic Error
Q-0-99.message_template: Uncategorized Error. This should never appear in production, and is a bug in Quarto.

Q-1-1.title: YAML Syntax Error
Q-1-1.message_template: There is a syntax error in the YAML document being parsed.

Q-1-10.title: Missing Required Property
Q-1-10.message_template: A required property is missing from the YAML document.

Q-1-11.title: Type Mismatch
Q-1-11.message_template: The value has an incorrect type (expected one type, got another).

Q-1-12.title: Invalid Enum Value
Q-1-12.message_template: The value is not one of the allowed enumeration values.

Q-1-13.title: Array Length Constraint Violation
Q-1-13.message_template: The array length does not meet the minimum or maximum item constraints.

Q-1-14.title: String Pattern Mismatch
Q-1-14.message_template: The string value does not match the required pattern.

Q-1-15.title: Number Range Violation
Q-1-15.message_template: The numeric value is outside the allowed range or not a valid multiple.

Q-1-16.title: Object Property Count Violation
Q-1-16.message_template: The object has too many or too few properties.

Q-1-17.title: Unresolved Schema Reference
Q-1-17.message_template: A $ref reference in the schema could not be resolved.

Q-1-18.title: Unknown Property
Q-1-18.message_template: An unknown property was found in a closed object schema.

Q-1-19.title: Array Uniqueness Violation
Q-1-19.message_template: Array items must be unique but duplicates were found.

Q-1-20.title: Failed to parse metadata value as markdown
Q-1-20.message_template: Invalid markdown will be interpreted as a string. Consider adding a '!str' tag to the entry.

Q-1-21.title: Unknown Tag Component
Q-1-21.message_template: Unknown component in YAML tag. Valid components are: prefer, concat, md, str, path, glob, expr.

Q-1-22.title: Unrecognized Tag
Q-1-22.message_template: Unrecognized YAML tag. Valid tags include: prefer, concat, md, str, path, glob, expr.

Q-1-23.title: Config Layer Parse Failure
Q-1-23.message_template: Failed to parse a configuration layer. Check the YAML syntax in the specified file.

Q-1-24.title: Empty Tag Component
Q-1-24.message_template: YAML tag contains an empty component. Check for leading, trailing, or consecutive commas.

Q-1-25.title: Whitespace in Tag
Q-1-25.message_template: YAML tag contains whitespace. Remove spaces around tag components.

Q-1-26.title: Invalid Tag Character
Q-1-26.message_template: YAML tag contains invalid characters. Only letters, numbers, and commas are allowed.

Q-1-27.title: Config Nesting Too Deep
Q-1-27.message_template: Configuration nesting exceeds maximum depth. Simplify the configuration structure.

Q-1-28.title: Conflicting Merge Operations
Q-1-28.message_template: YAML tag specifies both 'prefer' and 'concat'. Use only one merge operation per tag.

Q-1-29.title: String Length Constraint Violation
Q-1-29.message_template: The string length does not meet the schema's minimum or maximum length constraint.

Q-2-1.title: Unclosed Span
Q-2-1.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing ']' for the span or link.

Q-2-2.title: Mismatched Delimiter in Attribute Specifier
Q-2-2.message_template: I expected a '}', language specifier, an identifier, a class specifier, or a key-value pair.

Q-2-3.title: Key-value Pair Before Class Specifier in Attribute
Q-2-3.message_template: This class specifier appears after the key-value pair.

Q-2-4.title: Missing Space After Div Fence
Q-2-4.message_template: A space is required after ':::' when specifying div attributes.

Q-2-5.title: Unclosed Emphasis
Q-2-5.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '_' for the emphasis.

Q-2-7.title: Unclosed Single Quote
Q-2-7.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing "'" for the quote.

Q-2-8.title: Unsupported Code Block Syntax
Q-2-8.message_template: Quarto Markdown requires executable code block options in YAML.

Q-2-9.title: HTML Element Auto-converted
Q-2-9.message_template: HTML elements are automatically converted to raw HTML inlines.

Q-2-10.title: Closing Quote Without Matching Open Quote
Q-2-10.message_template: A space is causing a quote mark to be interpreted as a quotation close.

Q-2-11.title: Unclosed Double Quote
Q-2-11.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '"' for the quote.

Q-2-12.title: Unclosed Star Emphasis
Q-2-12.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '*' for the emphasis.

Q-2-13.title: Unclosed Strong Star Emphasis
Q-2-13.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '**' for the strong emphasis.

Q-2-14.title: Unclosed Underscore Emphasis
Q-2-14.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '_' for the emphasis.

Q-2-15.title: Unclosed Strong Underscore Emphasis
Q-2-15.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '__' for the strong emphasis.

Q-2-16.title: Unclosed Superscript
Q-2-16.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '^' for the superscript.

Q-2-17.title: Unclosed Subscript
Q-2-17.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '~' for the subscript.

Q-2-18.title: Unclosed Strikeout
Q-2-18.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '~~' for the strikeout.

Q-2-19.title: Unclosed Editorial Insert
Q-2-19.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing ']' for the editorial insert.

Q-2-20.title: Unclosed Editorial Delete
Q-2-20.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing ']' for the editorial delete.

Q-2-21.title: Unclosed Editorial Comment
Q-2-21.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing ']' for the editorial comment.

Q-2-22.title: Unclosed Editorial Highlight
Q-2-22.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing ']' for the editorial highlight.

Q-2-23.title: Unclosed Inline Math
Q-2-23.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '$' for the inline math.

Q-2-24.title: Unclosed Code Span
Q-2-24.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '`' for the code span.

Q-2-25.title: Unclosed Image
Q-2-25.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '](url)' for the image.

Q-2-26.title: Unclosed Inline Footnote
Q-2-26.message_template: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing ']' for the inline footnote.

Q-2-27.title: Line Break Before Shortcode Close
Q-2-27.message_template: Line breaks are not allowed immediately before the shortcode closing delimiter `>}}`.

Q-2-28.title: Line Break Before Escaped Shortcode Close
Q-2-28.message_template: Line breaks are not allowed immediately before the escaped shortcode closing delimiter `>}}}`.

Q-2-29.title: Indented Footnote Content Not Supported
Q-2-29.message_template: Quarto markdown does not support indented footnote content. Use the div syntax instead: `::: ^ref ... :::`

Q-2-30.title: Multi-Paragraph Footnote Indentation Not Supported
Q-2-30.message_template: Indented paragraph following footnote definition suggests Pandoc multi-paragraph footnote syntax, which is not supported in quarto-markdown. Use the div syntax instead: `::: ^ref ... :::`

Q-2-31.title: Inline Code Execution Not Allowed in URLs
Q-2-31.message_template: Inline code execution syntax (`{language} ...) cannot be used inside image or link destinations.

Q-2-32.title: Triple Star Emphasis Not Allowed
Q-2-32.message_template: Quarto Markdown doesn't support `***`. Consider using `*__` instead.

Q-2-33.title: Spaces in Link Targets
Q-2-33.message_template: Link targets cannot contain spaces. Replace spaces with %20.

Q-2-34.title: Unquoted Shortcode Parameter Starting with Digit
Q-2-34.message_template: Shortcode parameter values starting with digits must be quoted.

Q-2-35.title: Invalid List-Table Structure
Q-2-35.message_template: A div with class 'list-table' has an invalid structure and cannot be converted to a table.

Q-2-39.title: Grid tables are not supported
Q-2-39.message_template: Grid tables aren't supported. Use a list table instead.

Q-2-40.title: Engine Specification Ignored for Markdown Input
Q-2-40.message_template: `.md` documents never execute engines; the engine specification has no effect.

Q-3-1.title: IO Error During Write
Q-3-1.message_template: An I/O error occurred while writing output.

Q-3-10.title: Inline Note Definition Not Supported
Q-3-10.message_template: Inline note definitions ([^id]: content) cannot be rendered in this output format because they require content coalescing, which is not yet implemented.

Q-3-11.title: Fenced Note Definition Not Supported
Q-3-11.message_template: Fenced note definitions cannot be rendered in this output format because they require content coalescing, which is not yet implemented.

Q-3-12.title: Unresolved Note Reference
Q-3-12.message_template: A note reference was not converted to a Span during postprocessing. This is a bug in the postprocessor.

Q-3-20.title: Block Metadata Not Supported
Q-3-20.message_template: YAML metadata blocks are internal AST nodes that cannot be rendered in this output format.

Q-3-21.title: Caption Block Not Supported
Q-3-21.message_template: Standalone caption blocks cannot be rendered in this output format. Captions should be attached to figures or tables.

Q-3-30.title: Shortcode Not Supported
Q-3-30.message_template: Quarto shortcodes are not representable in this output format.

Q-3-31.title: Unprocessed Note Reference
Q-3-31.message_template: Note reference was not converted to Span during postprocessing. This may indicate a bug or a filter that bypassed postprocessing.

Q-3-32.title: Standalone Attribute Not Supported
Q-3-32.message_template: Standalone attributes (e.g., in table cells or headings) are not representable in this output format.

Q-3-33.title: Unprocessed Insert Markup
Q-3-33.message_template: Insert editorial markup ([++...]) was not desugared to Span during postprocessing.

Q-3-34.title: Unprocessed Delete Markup
Q-3-34.message_template: Delete editorial markup ([--...]) was not desugared to Span during postprocessing.

Q-3-35.title: Unprocessed Highlight Markup
Q-3-35.message_template: Highlight editorial markup ([!!...]) was not desugared to Span during postprocessing.

Q-3-36.title: Unprocessed EditComment Markup
Q-3-36.message_template: EditComment editorial markup ([>>...]) was not desugared to Span during postprocessing.

Q-3-40.title: Invalid Metadata Structure
Q-3-40.message_template: Document metadata must be a map structure for this output format.

Q-3-42.title: Shortcode edit dropped
Q-3-42.message_template: An edit to shortcode-resolved (or other atomic-Generated) content was reverted. The resolved text is read-only; edit the invocation token in source instead.

Q-3-43.title: Generated content edit dropped
Q-3-43.message_template: An edit to pipeline-generated content was reverted. The content has no editable source position in this file; edit its upstream definition (an include, metadata key, or other source) instead.

Q-3-50.title: LineBlock Not Supported in ANSI Format
Q-3-50.message_template: LineBlock elements cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

Q-3-51.title: CodeBlock Not Supported in ANSI Format
Q-3-51.message_template: CodeBlock elements cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

Q-3-52.title: Table Not Supported in ANSI Format
Q-3-52.message_template: Table elements cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

Q-3-53.title: Figure Not Supported in ANSI Format
Q-3-53.message_template: Figure elements cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

Q-3-54.title: NoteDefinitionPara Not Supported in ANSI Format
Q-3-54.message_template: Note definitions cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

Q-3-55.title: NoteDefinitionFencedBlock Not Supported in ANSI Format
Q-3-55.message_template: Fenced note definitions cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

Q-9-1.title: XML Syntax Error
Q-9-1.message_template: There is a syntax error in the XML document being parsed.

Q-9-2.title: Unexpected End of XML Input
Q-9-2.message_template: The XML document ended unexpectedly before parsing was complete.

Q-9-3.title: Mismatched XML End Tag
Q-9-3.message_template: An XML end tag does not match its corresponding start tag.

Q-9-4.title: Invalid XML Structure
Q-9-4.message_template: The XML document has an invalid structure.

Q-9-5.title: Empty XML Document
Q-9-5.message_template: The XML document contains no root element.

Q-9-6.title: Multiple XML Root Elements
Q-9-6.message_template: The XML document contains multiple root elements, which is not valid XML.

Q-9-7.title: Missing Required Attribute
Q-9-7.message_template: A required attribute is missing from a CSL element.

Q-9-8.title: Invalid Attribute Value
Q-9-8.message_template: An attribute value in the CSL file is not valid.

Q-9-9.title: Missing Required Element
Q-9-9.message_template: A required child element is missing from a CSL element.

Q-9-10.title: Unexpected Element
Q-9-10.message_template: An element appears in an unexpected location in the CSL file.

Q-9-11.title: Missing Text Source
Q-9-11.message_template: A text element must specify a source (variable, macro, term, or value).

Q-9-12.title: Undefined Macro
Q-9-12.message_template: A macro reference refers to a macro that is not defined.

Q-9-13.title: Circular Macro Dependency
Q-9-13.message_template: Macro references form a circular dependency.

Q-9-14.title: Duplicate Macro Definition
Q-9-14.message_template: A macro is defined more than once.

Q-9-15.title: Invalid CSL Version
Q-9-15.message_template: The CSL version string is not valid.

Q-9-16.title: Invalid Root Element
Q-9-16.message_template: CSL document must have <style> as the root element.

Q-10-1.title: Template Parse Error
Q-10-1.message_template: Failed to parse the template syntax.

Q-10-2.title: Undefined Variable
Q-10-2.message_template: The variable referenced in the template is not defined in the context.

Q-10-3.title: Partial Not Found
Q-10-3.message_template: The referenced partial template file could not be found.

Q-10-4.title: Recursive Partial
Q-10-4.message_template: Partial templates are nested too deeply, possibly indicating infinite recursion.

Q-10-5.title: Unresolved Partial Reference
Q-10-5.message_template: A partial reference was not resolved during template compilation.

Q-10-6.title: Unknown Pipe
Q-10-6.message_template: The pipe transformation specified in the template is not recognized.

Q-10-7.title: Invalid Pipe Arguments
Q-10-7.message_template: The arguments provided to the pipe transformation are invalid.

Q-5-1.title: Resource Path Resolves Outside the Project Root
Q-5-1.message_template: A `resources:` pattern in `_quarto.yml` or a document frontmatter resolves to a path outside the project root. Project resources must live within the project directory. A leading `/` is treated as project-root-relative, e.g. `/docs/foo.json` means `<project>/docs/foo.json`.

Q-5-2.title: Invalid Glob Pattern in `resources:`
Q-5-2.message_template: A `resources:` glob pattern in `_quarto.yml` or a document frontmatter is malformed and could not be parsed as a glob.

Q-5-3.title: Failed Walking Glob Matches for `resources:`
Q-5-3.message_template: An I/O error occurred while enumerating files that match a `resources:` glob.

Q-5-4.title: Example Embed Missing `file=`
Q-5-4.message_template: An `.embed-example-iframe` placeholder has no `file=` attribute, so there is no asset to embed. Add `file="path/to/asset.html"` naming a project-relative static asset.

Q-5-5.title: Example Embed Target Is Not a Static Asset
Q-5-5.message_template: An `.embed-example-iframe` `file=` points at a source document (e.g. a `.qmd`) that would need rendering. The embed target must be a pre-rendered static asset, such as a `.html` file.

Q-5-6.title: Referenced Resource Not Found
Q-5-6.message_template: A document references a resource file (for example an image) whose source does not exist on disk, so it cannot be copied into the output. Check the path in the reference, or add the missing file. The render continues without it.

Q-5-7.title: Resource Copy Failed
Q-5-7.message_template: Quarto could not copy a referenced resource into the output directory because of a filesystem error, such as a permission problem or insufficient disk space. The render cannot complete until the underlying filesystem condition is resolved.

Q-7-1.title: Missing Newline at End of File
Q-7-1.message_template: The input file does not end with a newline.

Q-7-2.title: Input Path Not Found
Q-7-2.message_template: The input path passed to `quarto render` does not exist on disk.

Q-7-3.title: No Input and No Project
Q-7-3.message_template: `quarto render` was called with no path arguments and no `_quarto.yml` was found at or above the current directory.

Q-7-4.title: Multiple Inputs Without a Project
Q-7-4.message_template: `quarto render` requires a project (a `_quarto.yml`-rooted directory) when given multiple input paths. To render a single standalone file, pass exactly one path.

Q-7-5.title: Inputs Span Multiple Projects
Q-7-5.message_template: The input paths span more than one project. Render one project at a time.

Q-7-6.title: Input Excluded From Render List
Q-7-6.message_template: The named input is excluded from its project's render list (check `project.render` in `_quarto.yml` and the underscore/hidden file conventions).

Q-7-7.title: No Renderable Files Matched
Q-7-7.message_template: The directory or glob input expanded to zero renderable `.qmd` files after the project's render list was applied.

Q-7-8.title: Project Discovery Failed
Q-7-8.message_template: Project discovery failed (parse error in `_quarto.yml`, I/O error, or other unrelated failure).

Q-11-1.title: Lua Filter Diagnostic
Q-11-1.message_template: A diagnostic was emitted by a Lua filter via quarto.warn() or quarto.error().

Q-11-2.title: SimpleTable Is Not Supported
Q-11-2.message_template: Quarto does not implement the legacy pre-pandoc-2.10 SimpleTable API (pandoc.SimpleTable, pandoc.utils.to_simple_table, pandoc.utils.from_simple_table). Use pandoc.Table instead.

Q-11-3.title: Invalid Lua Argument
Q-11-3.message_template: A value passed to a pandoc.* constructor or function has the wrong type. The error states the expected type and what was received.

Q-11-4.title: Invalid Lua Filter Return Value
Q-11-4.message_template: A Lua filter function returned a value that cannot be converted to AST elements. Return nil (keep the element), an element, a list of elements, or (for inline contexts) a string.

Q-11-5.title: Invalid Lua Property Assignment
Q-11-5.message_template: An assignment to an AST element property was rejected: the field is read-only, unknown for this element type, or the value has the wrong type.

Q-12-1.title: Custom Listing Template Not Yet Supported
Q-12-1.message_template: Custom listing templates land in a follow-up (bd-rqgx). For now, this listing falls back to the `default` built-in. Set `type: default | grid | table` to silence this diagnostic.

Q-12-2.title: Inline Listing Contents Not Yet Supported
Q-12-2.message_template: An inline metadata record in `contents:` is not yet supported. The entry is skipped; glob entries continue to process.

Q-12-3.title: Unknown Sort Field
Q-12-3.message_template: The field referenced by `sort:` is not a recognized listing-item field.

Q-12-4.title: Listing Id Collision
Q-12-4.message_template: Two listings on the same page declare the same `id`. The first one wins; later ones are dropped.

Q-12-5.title: Invalid field-display-names Value
Q-12-5.message_template: `field-display-names` entries must map field names to display strings. Non-string values are dropped.

Q-12-6.title: listing: false Not Allowed
Q-12-6.message_template: `listing: false` is not a valid value. Listings are page-local; remove the key entirely or set `listing: true` for a default listing.

Q-12-7.title: template Requires type: custom
Q-12-7.message_template: A `template:` field was set but `type:` is not `custom`. Falling back to the built-in template for the declared type.

Q-12-8.title: Listing Template File Missing
Q-12-8.message_template: The file referenced by `template:` could not be found relative to the host page.

Q-12-9.title: Deprecated .ejs.md Template Extension
Q-12-9.message_template: The `.ejs.md` template extension is a Q1 idiom and is not supported by Q2 doctemplate. See the Q1 → Q2 migration guide.

Q-12-10.title: Listing Markdown Re-parse Diagnostics
Q-12-10.message_template: Re-parsing the doctemplate output of a listing produced one or more diagnostics. The first diagnostic is included; full source-info threading is a follow-up (bd-0jyl).

Q-12-11.title: Mixed Category Modes On One Page
Q-12-11.message_template: Two or more listings on this page declare different `categories:` modes; the first non-disabled mode in declaration order wins for the rendered sidebar. Set the same mode on every listing, or set `categories: false` on the listings whose mode you do not want to use.

Q-12-12.title: Categories Enabled But No Item Has Any
Q-12-12.message_template: A listing on this page sets `categories:` to a non-disabled mode, but no resolved listing item has any categories defined; the categories sidebar is suppressed. Add `categories: [...]` to the listing's content posts (in their frontmatter or `listing-item:` block), or set `categories: false` to silence this warning.

Q-12-13.title: Listing Item Produced No Preview Content
Q-12-13.message_template: Listing item from {href} produced no preview content; using static fallback description. The sibling output file is missing or has no usable first paragraph; the listing remains correct but uses the description from the post's frontmatter / first source paragraph rather than the engine-rendered output.

Q-12-14.title: Listing Type custom Without template Path
Q-12-14.message_template: A `type: custom` listing requires a `template:` field pointing at a doctemplate file. Falling back to the built-in `default` template.

Q-12-15.title: Listing Feed Skipped: Missing site-url
Q-12-15.message_template: A listing has `feed:` configured, but the project's `website.site-url` is missing. Feeds require an absolute base URL to construct item links. Set `website.site-url` in `_quarto.yml` to enable feed generation. The listing host page renders correctly otherwise.

Q-12-16.title: Listing Feed: Sibling Output Unreadable
Q-12-16.message_template: While building a listing feed, the substitution step tried to read the rendered HTML at {path} for an item but the file could not be opened. The feed was emitted with an empty `<description>` for this item. Re-running the project render usually resolves transient I/O issues; persistent failures suggest a misconfigured output directory.

Q-12-17.title: Listing Contents Pattern Outside Project
Q-12-17.message_template: A listing `contents:` pattern resolves outside the project directory and matches nothing. Patterns resolve relative to the directory of the file they are written in; `..` segments may not climb above the project root.

Q-12-18.title: Invalid Glob Pattern in Listing `contents:`
Q-12-18.message_template: A listing `contents:` pattern is not a valid glob and matches nothing.

Q-12-19.title: Listing `contents:` Pattern Matched Nothing
Q-12-19.message_template: A listing `contents:` pattern matched no project documents.

Q-13-1.title: Sidebar references missing document
Q-13-1.message_template: A `website.sidebar` entry references a path that is not in the project index. The referenced path is reported as a missing document. Check the spelling, or confirm the target file is included in the render set.

Q-13-2.title: Navbar references missing document
Q-13-2.message_template: A `website.navbar` entry references a path that is not in the project index. The referenced path is reported as a missing document. Check the spelling, or confirm the target file is included in the render set.

Q-13-3.title: Page footer references missing document
Q-13-3.message_template: A `website.page-footer` entry references a path that is not in the project index. The referenced path is reported as a missing document. Check the spelling, or confirm the target file is included in the render set.

Q-13-4.title: Body link references missing document
Q-13-4.message_template: An inline link in the document body references a `.qmd` path that is not in the project index. The referenced path is reported as a missing document. Check the spelling, or confirm the target file is included in the render set. The link is preserved verbatim in the rendered output so the dangling reference is visible to readers.

Q-13-5.title: Sidebar `auto:` ignored
Q-13-5.message_template: A sidebar `auto:` entry was dropped because no project index is available to expand it. This usually means the document is being rendered standalone rather than as part of a project. Render this document inside a project to expand `auto:` entries.

Q-13-6.title: Sidebar `auto:` matched no documents
Q-13-6.message_template: A sidebar `auto:` entry was expanded against the project index but matched no documents. The entry is dropped from the rendered sidebar. Check the path or glob pattern in the `auto:` spec, or confirm the target files exist in the project.

Q-13-7.title: Page navigation references missing document
Q-13-7.message_template: A `prev:` or `next:` page-navigation entry references a path that is not in the project index. The referenced path is reported as a missing document. Check the spelling, or confirm the target file is included in the render set.

Q-14-1.title: Invalid theme configuration
Q-14-1.message_template: The `theme:` value in `_quarto.yml` or document metadata is not a recognized shape. Use a single theme name (e.g. `theme: cosmo`), an array of names (e.g. `theme: [cosmo, custom.scss]`), or `theme: none` to suppress Bootstrap.

Q-14-2.title: Unknown theme name
Q-14-2.message_template: The `theme:` value names a theme Quarto does not recognize. Use one of the built-in Bootswatch theme names (e.g. `cosmo`, `darkly`), a path to a `.scss`/`.css` file, or `theme: none` to suppress Bootstrap.

Q-15-1.title: Duplicate Crossref Identifier
Q-15-1.message_template: A crossref identifier (e.g. a `fig-`/`tbl-` label or an explicit `#id`) is defined more than once in the same document. Each crossref id must be unique within a document, so a reference like `@fig-foo` resolves to exactly one target. Give one of the targets a different label.

Q-5-8.title: Project Render Script Failed
Q-5-8.message_template: A `project.pre-render` or `project.post-render` script exited with a non-zero status (or was terminated by a signal). The render is aborted; remaining scripts in the list do not run. The script's own output appears above the diagnostic — fix the script (or remove it from `_quarto.yml`) and render again.

Q-5-9.title: Pre-render Script Changed a Forbidden Project Setting
Q-5-9.message_template: While `project.pre-render` scripts ran, `_quarto.yml` changed its `project.type` or `project.output-dir`. Pre-render scripts may modify the project — add input files, edit configuration — but these two settings must stay fixed, because the scripts already received `QUARTO_PROJECT_OUTPUT_DIR` computed from them. Make the change directly in `_quarto.yml` instead of from a script.

Q-5-10.title: Project Render Script Could Not Be Launched
Q-5-10.message_template: Quarto could not start a `project.pre-render` / `project.post-render` script. Common causes: the interpreter is not on PATH (set `QUARTO_PYTHON`, `QUARTO_R`, or `QUARTO_NODE` to override discovery), a directly-executed script is missing its shebang line or executable bit, or the script path does not exist. The entry can also be an explicit command line, e.g. `pre-render: python3 tools/gen.py`.

Q-5-11.title: Unknown Project Key (Underscore Spelling)
Q-5-11.message_template: `_quarto.yml` contains `project.pre_render` or `project.post_render` (underscore spelling), which is not a recognized key and is ignored. Project render scripts are configured with the hyphenated keys `project.pre-render` / `project.post-render`.

Q-5-12.title: Project Render Scripts Unsupported in This Environment
Q-5-12.message_template: The project configures `project.pre-render` / `project.post-render` scripts, but the current environment (the browser-based hub preview) cannot run subprocesses, so the scripts are skipped and the preview renders without them. Run `q2 render` on a machine with the required interpreters to execute the scripts.

Q-5-16.title: `resources:` Pattern Matched No Files
Q-5-16.message_template: A `resources:` glob matched no files, so nothing was published for it.

Q-5-13.title: `project.render` Pattern Matched No Files
Q-5-13.message_template: A `project.render` pattern matched no renderable `.qmd` files, so it contributed nothing to the render list.

Q-5-14.title: `project.render` Pattern Outside the Project Root
Q-5-14.message_template: A `project.render` pattern's `..` segments climb above the project root, so it matches nothing.

Q-5-15.title: Invalid Glob Pattern in `project.render`
Q-5-15.message_template: A `project.render` pattern is not a valid glob and matches nothing.

Q-5-17.title: Unknown Project Type
Q-5-17.message_template: `project.type` in `_quarto.yml` is not one of the supported types (`default`, `website`, `book`, `manuscript`), or is not a string. Quarto 1 extension project types (contributed from `_extensions/`) are not yet supported in Quarto 2; set `project.type` to the base type the extension extends (often `website`). The render stops before any document is processed — continuing under the wrong project type would scatter per-document copies of shared JS/CSS next to every source file.

Q-16-1.title: Extension Not Loaded
Q-16-1.message_template: An `_extension.yml` manifest could not be read or parsed, so the extension it describes is not active for this render. Any shortcodes, filters, or formats it contributes will be missing (a shortcode from it will report Q-16-3 Unknown Shortcode at its use site). The message names the manifest file and the underlying cause; fix the manifest to restore the extension.

Q-16-2.title: Shortcode Script Load Failure
Q-16-2.message_template: A Lua shortcode script (from an extension's `contributes.shortcodes` or the document's `shortcodes:` list) failed to load or execute. Handlers defined by that script are unavailable; shortcodes relying on them will report Q-16-3 Unknown Shortcode. The message names the script file (and extension, when applicable) and the Lua error.

Q-16-3.title: Unknown Shortcode
Q-16-3.message_template: A shortcode invocation does not match any built-in handler, extension-contributed handler, or document-level `shortcodes:` script. The invocation renders as a visible `?name` marker. Check the shortcode name for typos, and check earlier Q-16-1/Q-16-2 warnings — a failed extension or script load surfaces here at the use site.

Q-16-4.title: Shortcode Handler Shadowed
Q-16-4.message_template: Two loaded shortcode scripts define a handler with the same name; the later registration wins (document `shortcodes:` scripts load first, then extensions in discovery order, so the more local definition takes precedence). This is informational — overriding a built-in extension is a supported pattern — but if the shadowing is unintentional, rename or remove one of the handlers.

Q-16-5.title: Shortcode Value Not Found
Q-16-5.message_template: A value-lookup shortcode (`meta`, `var`, `env`) could not resolve its key: the metadata key is absent, the variable is not defined in `_variables.yml`, or the environment variable is unset and no fallback argument was given. The invocation renders as a visible `?name` marker. Check the key for typos, define it at the source the shortcode reads from, or (for `env`) pass a fallback: `{{< env NAME fallback >}}`.

Q-16-6.title: Block Shortcode In Inline Position
Q-16-6.message_template: A shortcode used inline (inside a sentence or other inline content) produced block-level output (for example a raw HTML block from the `video` shortcode), and none of it could be carried into the inline position — the output was dropped. Put the shortcode in its own paragraph, surrounded by blank lines.

Q-17-1.title: Circular Include
Q-17-1.message_template: An `{{< include >}}` chain leads back to a file that is already being included, directly or indirectly. The cyclic include is skipped and its content is omitted from the output. Break the cycle by removing one of the includes in the chain.

Q-17-2.title: Include File Not Found
Q-17-2.message_template: The file named by an `{{< include >}}` shortcode could not be read. The include is skipped and its content is omitted from the output. The path is resolved relative to the directory of the file containing the shortcode — check it for typos and check that the file exists.

Q-17-3.title: Include File Parse Error
Q-17-3.message_template: The file named by an `{{< include >}}` shortcode was read but could not be parsed as qmd. The include is skipped and its content is omitted from the output. The included file's own parse errors are reported alongside this one — fix those and the include will succeed.

Q-17-4.title: Include Not Expanded Here
Q-17-4.message_template: An `{{< include >}}` shortcode appears in a position where include expansion does not apply, so it was not expanded. Includes are only expanded when the shortcode is the sole content of its own paragraph. Put the shortcode on its own line, surrounded by blank lines.
